subject: Model-v1 sunset orchestration, exemption workflow & comms timing
messages:
From: Sima Patel <sima@acme-data.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Question on model-v1 sunset timeline and extended support request

Hi Jonas,

Quick question — we saw the notice about the planned phase-out of the model-v1 endpoint. Can you share the official sunset date and what the migration window will look like? We run several critical customer-facing features on model-v1 (embedding+generation) and need to know timelines for contract/procurement planning.

Separately, several of our customers (notably FinCo) have asked whether extended support/exemption options exist — they want another 6–9 months on v1 or a managed migration by Redwood. Are exemption requests something you’ll entertain? If so, what is the escalation route and who signs off?

Thanks — would appreciate the concrete dates so I can coordinate with procurement.

Best,
Sima
Lead Data Engineer
Acme Data

Subject: Re: Question on model-v1 sunset timeline and extended support request

Forwarding Sima's ask to product, CS and sales. High-level proposal below so we can align before I send a formal response:

- Proposed public sunset date: 2026-11-30 (final shutdown of model-v1 endpoint).
- Migration grace period (customers with active paid contracts): until 2027-02-28 for dual-run / mitigations. After that we will return 410 for v1 requests.
- Exemption policy: manual approval for customer requests, limited to 3–6 months beyond the grace period on a case-by-case basis. Approvals require sign-off from Sales (Karthik) + Product (Laura) for technical feasibility and CS (Marissa) for support capacity.

Ask for product: can we provide a precise list of incompatibilities between model-v1 and the recommended replacement (model-v2-compat)? We need: breaking API fields, tokenization diffs, and recommended SDK shim and migration flags. Also need an SDK-level deprecation warning (client-side) as soon as next release.

Ask for ops/infra: plan for canary and traffic split for the replacement model (route-level feature flag), and an automatic fallback policy for customers where compatibility check fails.

I've attached a draft timeline and an exemption request template for review (sunset_timeline_v1.xlsx, exemption_template.docx). Marissa — can you draft the external customer email and a short how-to migration guide to include in the comms?

I will not send the external note until we agree on dates and exemption process (and legal/contract implications).

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks — this looks reasonable as a starting point. A few product asks / clarifications:

1) Compatibility matrix: I'll produce a short doc listing field-level changes (response envelope, streaming framing, new function-calling contract). ETA: 2026-08-10.
2) SDK behavior: agree on an immediate deprecation warning in SDKs (next patch) and a one-click flag to enable "compat-mode" for a limited period. Need engineering estimate for "compat-mode" shim (2–3 sprints?).
3) Canary plan: propose a 3-week canary with 5% -> 25% -> 50% traffic steps. We need to define SLO rollback triggers (token error rate > 1% or latency 2x).
4) Exemption rules: technical exemptions (incompatibility that requires code-level changes) vs commercial exemptions (contract terms). Product should only sign tech feas; Karthik should own commercial terms.

I'll attach the initial compatibility checklist to the shared doc once ready. Also recommend we schedule a 30-minute cross-functional sync tomorrow to lock on dates.

Sima — thanks for raising this and apologies for the delay while we aligned internally. TL;DR: proposed dates and next steps below.

Official public sunset (v1 returns 410): 2026-11-30
Grace period for paid customers to run dual-mode and migrate: 2027-02-28
Exemption route: yes — customers can submit an exemption request using the attached template (exemption_template.docx). Requests are reviewed by Sales + Product + CS; approval can grant up to a 6-month extension beyond 2027-02-28 in exceptional cases (contract/technical).

What we will provide:
- Migration compatibility checklist & quick-code examples (Laura will share by 2026-08-10).
- SDK deprecation warning in the next client patch and a temporary "compat-mode" flag for customers during the migration window.
- A canary rollout for model-v2 with explicit rollback SLOs (5% -> 25% -> 50%).
- Optional migration session: schedule via this form: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcSunsetComms (link to booking + playbook).

Next steps for Acme Data / FinCo:
1) If you need an exemption, fill the attached exemption_template.docx and send to procurement@redwood.com.
2) Book a migration session (I'll loop in engineering if needed).
3) We'll prioritize top-10 customers for code-level migration guides and offer managed migration SOWs if required.

If you want, I can join a call with FinCo procurement next week to walk through the timeline and options — tell me a few availability windows.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Product Operations
